ei.title: 37번 — Exotic Species: Grey vs Red Squirrels
ei.subject: 6월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 37번 — Exotic Species: Grey vs Red Squirrels

fullPassage:
Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem.

(A) The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite.

(B) Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure.

(C) Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.

questions.passage: Problems often ①<u>arise</u> if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt ②<u>it's</u> diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ③<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have ④<u>survived</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② it's → its: '자신의 먹이'라는 소유의 뜻이므로 소유격 its가 옳다. it's는 it is의 줄임말
det.analysis:
✅ ① arise: 주어 Problems(복수)에 맞는 현재형 동사예요. 올바름

❌ ② it's → its: 'it can adapt ②___ diet'는 '그것(회색 다람쥐)이 자신의 먹이를 바꾼다'는 뜻이에요. 뒤의 명사 diet를 꾸며 '~의(자신의)'를 나타내려면 소유격 its를 써야 해요. it's는 'it is(그것은 ~이다)'의 줄임말이라 여기에 쓰면 'it is diet'가 되어 말이 안 돼요. ←정답

✅ ③ competed: 과거의 일이라 과거형이 맞아요. 올바름

✅ ④ survived: 'have survived'로 현재완료를 이루는 과거분사예요. 올바름
det.tip: its(그것의, 소유격) ↔ it's(it is의 줄임말). 명사 앞 '~의'는 its

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly ①<u>introduced</u> to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only ②<u>digest</u> mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ③<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more ④<u>easy</u> when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ easy → easily: 동사 survived를 꾸미는 자리이므로 부사 easily가 옳다
det.analysis:
✅ ① introduced: 'is introduced'로 '도입되다'라는 수동태를 이루는 과거분사예요. 올바름

✅ ② digest: 조동사 can 뒤의 동사원형이에요(소화하다). 올바름

✅ ③ competed: 과거형이에요. 올바름

❌ ④ easy → easily: 'have survived more ④___'에서 '얼마나 살아남았는가'를 나타내며 동사 survived를 꾸미는 자리예요. 동사를 꾸밀 때는 부사를 써야 하므로 easy(형용사)가 아니라 easily(부사)가 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: 동사를 꾸미면 부사: survived more easily (easy 아님)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey ①<u>had</u> the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so ③<u>having survived</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has ④<u>come</u> close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ having survived → have survived: 주어 Greys가 'can also live'와 'so ___ survived'를 나란히 받는 자리이므로, 준동사가 아닌 정동사 have survived가 옳다
det.analysis:
✅ ① had: 과거의 일이라 과거형이 맞아요(had the edge=우위를 점했다). 올바름

✅ ② competed: 과거형이에요. 올바름

❌ ③ having survived → have survived: 이 문장의 주어는 앞의 Greys예요. 'Greys can also live ~, so ③___ more easily'에서 and/so로 이어지는 두 번째 동사 자리라 문장을 이끄는 '정동사'가 필요해요. having survived(-ing)은 동사가 아닌 준동사라 문장을 이룰 수 없어요. 그래서 have survived로 써야 해요. ←정답

✅ ④ come: 'has come'으로 현재완료를 이루는 과거분사예요. 올바름
det.tip: so + (주어 생략) + 정동사: Greys ~ so have survived (having survived 아님)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly ①<u>introduced</u> to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can ②<u>reduce</u> its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ③<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more ④<u>densely</u> and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② reduce(줄이다) → adapt(바꾸다): 회색 다람쥐는 먹이를 '바꿀' 수 있어 풋도토리도 먹을 수 있었으므로 adapt가 옳다
det.analysis:
✅ ① introduced(도입된): 적절 — 외래종이 생태계에 도입될 때 문제가 생겨요.

❌ ② reduce(줄이다) → adapt(바꾸다): 원문은 '먹이를 바꾼다(adapt its diet)'예요. 뒤에 '풋도토리도 먹을 수 있다'가 이어져 먹이의 범위를 넓힌 것이므로, '줄이다(reduce)'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

✅ ③ competed(경쟁했다): 적절 — 두 종이 같은 먹이·서식지를 두고 경쟁해요.

✅ ④ densely(밀집하여): 적절 — 회색 다람쥐는 더 밀집해서 살 수 있어요.
det.tip: adapt one's diet = 먹이를 (상황에 맞게) 바꾸다. reduce(줄이다)와 반대

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly ①<u>introduced</u> to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have ③<u>perished</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to ④<u>extinction</u> in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ perished(죽었다/사라졌다) → survived(살아남았다): 회색 다람쥐는 서식지 파괴에도 더 쉽게 살아남았으므로 survived가 옳다
det.analysis:
✅ ① introduced(도입된): 적절 — 외래종이 생태계에 도입될 때 문제가 생겨요.

✅ ② competed(경쟁했다): 적절 — 두 종이 같은 먹이·서식지를 두고 경쟁해요.

❌ ③ perished(죽었다) → survived(살아남았다): 원문은 회색 다람쥐가 서식지 파괴에도 '더 쉽게 살아남았다(survived)'예요. 그래서 붉은 다람쥐가 밀려난 것이므로, '죽었다(perished)'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

✅ ④ extinction(멸종): 적절 — 붉은 다람쥐가 멸종에 가까워졌어요.
det.tip: survive(살아남다) ↔ perish(죽다/사라지다). 살아남은 쪽은 회색 다람쥐

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations __________. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: put ~ under pressure = ~을 압박하다/궁지에 몰다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: '~ competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations ___'(그것이 토종 붉은 다람쥐 개체군을 ___). 경쟁 탓에 붉은 다람쥐가 어려움을 겪었다는 흐름이라 '압박받는' 상태가 필요해요.

❌ ① at ease(편안한): 위협받는 상황과 반대예요.

❌ ② in control(장악한): 붉은 다람쥐가 오히려 밀린 상황이라 어울리지 않아요.

❌ ③ on alert(경계 태세인): 단순한 '경계'가 아니라 생존이 위협받는 압박이에요.

✅ ④ under pressure(압박을 받는): 경쟁으로 붉은 다람쥐 개체군이 궁지에 몰렸다는 흐름에 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: put ~ under pressure = ~을 압박하다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even __________. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: have a bite = 한 입 먹다. 붉은 다람쥐가 먹어 보기도 전에 먹이가 사라짐
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even ___'(회색 다람쥐는 붉은 다람쥐가 ___기도 전에 먹이 공급을 없앨 수 있다). 먹이가 사라진다는 문맥이라 '먹다'가 필요해요.

❌ ① fall asleep(잠들다): 먹이 경쟁과 관련이 없어요.

✅ ② have a bite(한 입 먹다): 붉은 다람쥐가 먹어 보기도 전에 먹이가 사라진다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ③ climb up(기어오르다): 먹이 이야기와 무관해요.

❌ ④ give up(포기하다): '먹기도 전에'라는 흐름과 연결되지 않아요.
det.tip: have a bite = 한 입 먹다 (먹이를 조금이라도 먹다)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: it is able ~ to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns — 회색은 풋도토리도 먹음
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 'it is able ~ to eat green acorns'와 일치해요. 회색 다람쥐는 아직 익지 않은 풋도토리(green acorns)도 먹을 수 있어요. ←정답

❌ ② 다양한 서식지에 사는 것은 '회색' 다람쥐예요(varied habitats). 붉은 다람쥐가 아니에요.

❌ ③ 회색 다람쥐는 1870년대에 아메리카에서 건너온 외래종이에요. 영국 토종은 붉은 다람쥐예요.

❌ ④ 두 종은 '같은(same)' 먹이와 서식지를 두고 경쟁했어요. '서로 다른'이 아니에요.
det.tip: green acorns=풋도토리(회색이 먹음) / mature acorns=다 자란 도토리(붉은만 소화)

ch: 회색 다람쥐는 아직 익지 않은 도토리도 먹을 수 있다.
붉은 다람쥐는 회색 다람쥐보다 서식지가 더 다양하다.
회색 다람쥐는 원래 영국에 살던 토종 종이다.
두 종의 다람쥐는 서로 다른 먹이를 두고 다투었다.

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s — 아메리카에서 영국으로 건너옴(방향 반대)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 'it can adapt its diet'와 일치해요(먹이를 바꿀 수 있음).

❌ ② 원문 'grey squirrels can destroy the food supply'와 일치해요.

❌ ③ 원문 'the red can only digest mature acorns'와 일치해요.

✅ ④ 여기가 정답(일치하지 않는 것)! 회색 다람쥐는 아메리카'에서' 영국'으로' 건너왔어요(arrived from America). '영국에서 아메리카로 건너갔다'는 방향이 정반대라 일치하지 않아요. ←정답
det.tip: arrived from America = 아메리카에서 (영국으로) 건너옴

ch: 회색 다람쥐는 먹이를 상황에 맞게 바꿀 수 있다.
회색 다람쥐가 붉은 다람쥐의 먹이 공급을 없앨 수 있다.
붉은 다람쥐는 다 자란 도토리만 소화할 수 있다.

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 'Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem'과 일치해요. ←정답

❌ ② 회색 다람쥐는 '다양한(varied)' 서식지에 살 수 있어요. 한 종류만이 아니에요.

❌ ③ 멸종 위기에 몰린 쪽은 '붉은' 다람쥐예요. 몰아넣은 쪽이 아니라 밀린 쪽이에요.

❌ ④ 삼림이 파괴되어도 회색 다람쥐가 '더 쉽게 살아남았어요'. 먼저 사라지는 게 아니에요.
det.tip: 외래종 유입 → 생태계 문제 (글의 도입부 주장)

ch: 외래종이 갑자기 유입되면 생태계에 문제가 생길 수 있다.
회색 다람쥐는 한 종류의 서식지에서만 살 수 있다.
붉은 다람쥐가 회색 다람쥐를 멸종 위기로 몰아넣었다.
삼림이 파괴되면 회색 다람쥐가 먼저 사라진다.

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체: 외래종 회색 다람쥐가 들어와 먹이·서식지 경쟁에서 앞서며 토종 붉은 다람쥐를 멸종 위기로 몰아넣음
det.analysis:

❌ ② '숲 보존 노력'은 본문에 나오지 않아요.

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
